effects.note: The source is an invented man made with Z-Image Turbo for this example; then inflate, seed 4103, our own render. The still took 26.8 s at 28.7 GB on its own; the numbers shown are the still + clip run, where the graph unloads Qwen before LTX loads (66 GB before that change). The clip starts on the photo and swells into the edit with no cross-fade: a glossy balloon rises from the lap and settles into the puffed jacket. The face drifts a little toward the edited still by the end. No person has listened to its sound.

matte.note: The source is our own LTX-2.5 render of an invented woman; the new set asked for a sunlit seaside boardwalk, seed 4104. The ProRes 4444 file (63 MB for 4 s) is made too but not kept here. The matte is soft: a little background shows between the legs, and the subject has no shadow on the new set.
